resources.string: Plays aerial videos of places around the world.
Dream Compose is the active screen saver
Dream Compose is not set as the screen saver
This device has no screen saver settings screen. On a TV, pick it in Settings → Device Preferences → Screen saver. Or enable the dream manually with:
adb shell settings put secure screensaver_components com.neilturner.dreamcompose/.dream.DreamService\nadb shell settings put secure screensaver_activate_on_sleep 1
